tilapia.name: Tilapia
tilapia.description: Nile tilapia, graded by weight and packed on ice.

sea_bass.name: Sea bass
sea_bass.description: European sea bass, also sold as branzino, graded by weight and packed on ice.

mullet.name: Grey mullet
mullet.description: Grey mullet, sold in Egypt as bouri, graded by weight and packed on ice; not the same fish as our thinlip mullet (tobar).

grass_carp.name: Grass carp
grass_carp.description: Grass carp, sold in Egypt as hashayesh and abroad as white amur, graded by weight and packed on ice.

mubarakah.name: Common carp
mubarakah.description: Fully scaled carp, sold in Egypt as qishra, graded by weight and packed on ice; we sell mirror carp (mabrouka) separately.

catfish.name: Catfish
catfish.description: African catfish, sold in Egypt as karmout, graded by weight and packed on ice.

lout.name: Meagre
lout.description: Meagre, sold in Egypt as lout and abroad as croaker or corvina, graded by weight and packed on ice.

thinlip_mullet.name: Thinlip mullet
thinlip_mullet.description: Thinlip mullet, sold in Egypt as tobar and packed on ice; not the same fish as our grey mullet (bouri).

bayad_catfish.name: Bayad catfish
bayad_catfish.description: Bayad, a catfish native to the Nile, packed on ice.

silver_carp.name: Silver carp
silver_carp.description: Silver carp, a freshwater carp, packed on ice.

mirror_carp.name: Mirror carp
mirror_carp.description: Carp with only a few large scales, sold in Egypt as mabrouka and packed on ice; we sell common carp (qishra) separately.

sea_bream.name: Sea bream
sea_bream.description: Gilthead sea bream, also sold as dorade, packed on ice.

eels.name: European eel
eels.description: European eel is a brackish-water fish.
